QF.id: XXVA Sales and Distribution of Research Services_9

question.text: Which of the following BEST reflects the qualities expected of the research information that a research entity provides to its clients?

answer.text: The aesthetics and design of the research report
Timely, accurate, objective, transparent, and reliable / useful information
The personal relationship between the sales person and the fund manager
The number of pages in each research report

explanation.text: The Logic: The framework for research services emphasises that research information should be timely, accurate, objective, transparent, and reliable / useful. These attributes are what give research its value to clients, regardless of segment. The Trap: Aesthetics, page count, and personal relationships are surface-level factors that do not capture the substantive qualities the framework expects from research output. Note: Advertising rules separately restrict references to past performance, so any framing built around a track-record-of-predictions claim would also need to comply with those advertisement restrictions.
